questions.question: What are the name, anatomy, typing and battle abilities of the evolution after Xatu?
What item enables that evolution, and how is it acquired?

description: The existing Psychic/Flying stage after Natu, reached at level 25. Its further regional evolution is a future design, not a replacement for this stage. Air Slash adds a Flying attack at evolution; later Wish and Future Sight offer delayed support and pressure. A capacity associated with foresight is not permission to reveal every plot secret.
